mapper.sql: adjustment_id, adjustment_no, client_request_id, request_fingerprint, adjustment_action, original_adjustment_id, shop_id, user_id, user_name, salary_month, source_day_result_id, source_schedule_id, source_business_date, target_day_result_id, target_schedule_id, target_business_date, adjustment_minutes, reason, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time
mapper.select: select day_result_id, schedule_id, user_id, user_name, shop_id, business_date, shift_id, scheduled_minutes, worked_minutes, paid_leave_minutes, unpaid_leave_minutes, absence_minutes, late_minutes, early_leave_minutes, result_status, exception_codes, settled_at, row_version from oa_attendance_day_result where day_result_id = #{dayResultId}
mapper.sql: SELECT t.source_day_result_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t.action='APPLY' THEN t.transfer_minutes WHEN t.action='REVERSE' THEN -t.transfer_minutes ELSE 0 END) transferred_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN t.action='APPLY' AND reversed.transfer_id IS NULL AND (d.day_result_id IS NULL OR d.settled_at IS NULL OR NOT(d.row_version <=> t.source_version) OR NOT(d.schedule_id <=> t.source_schedule_id) OR NOT(d.user_id <=> t.user_id) OR NOT(d.shop_id <=> t.shop_id) OR NOT(d.business_date <=> t.source_business_date) OR NOT(d.worked_minutes <=> t.source_worked_minutes) OR NOT(d.scheduled_minutes <=> t.source_scheduled_minutes) OR NOT(d.settled_at <=> t.source_settled_at) OR COALESCE(s.status,'')<>'PUBLISHED' OR NOT(s.user_id <=> t.user_id) OR NOT(s.shop_id <=> t.shop_id) OR NOT(s.business_date <=> t.source_business_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) invalid_count FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer t LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_overtime_transfer reversed ON reversed.original_transfer_id=t.transfer_id AND reversed.action='REVERSE' LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_day_result d ON d.day_result_id=t.source_day_result_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_schedule s ON s.schedule_id=d.schedule_id GROUP BY t.source_day_result_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action='APPLY' THEN transfer_minutes WHEN action='REVERSE' THEN -transfer_minutes ELSE 0 END),0) FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer WHERE source_day_result_id=#{sourceDayResultId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invalid_count),0) FROM () sources WHERE source_day_result_id=#{sourceDayResultId}
SELECT day_result_id FROM oa_attendance_day_result WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND business_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ORDER BY day_result_id FOR UPDATE

select d.day_result_id dayResultId, d.schedule_id scheduleId, d.business_date businessDate, coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, 0) scheduledMinutes, coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) workedMinutes, greatest(coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) - coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, 0), 0) rawOvertimeMinutes, coalesce(c.used_minutes, 0) usedMinutes, coalesce(ot.transferred_minutes,0) transferredMinutes, greatest(coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) - coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, 0), 0) - coalesce(c.used_minutes, 0) - coalesce(ot.transferred_minutes,0) availableMinutes from oa_attendance_day_result d left join ( select source_day_result_id, sum(case when adjustment_action = 'APPLY' then adjustment_minutes when adjustment_action = 'REVERSE' then -adjustment_minutes else 0 end) used_minutes from oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment group by source_day_result_id ) c on c.source_day_result_id = d.day_result_id LEFT JOIN () ot ON ot.source_day_result_id=d.day_result_id where d.shop_id = #{shopId} and d.user_id = #{userId} and d.business_date between #{monthStart} and #{targetDate} and d.settled_at is not null AND COALESCE(ot.invalid_count,0)=0 and greatest(coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) - coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, 0), 0) > coalesce(c.used_minutes, 0) + coalesce(ot.transferred_minutes,0) order by d.business_date, d.day_result_id

select a.adjustment_id, a.adjustment_no, a.client_request_id, a.request_fingerprint, a.adjustment_action, a.original_adjustment_id, a.shop_id, a.user_id, a.user_name, a.salary_month, a.source_day_result_id, a.source_schedule_id, a.source_business_date, a.target_day_result_id, a.target_schedule_id, a.target_business_date, a.adjustment_minutes, a.reason, a.operator_user_id, a.operator_name, a.create_by, a.create_time, case when r.adjustment_id is null then 0 else 1 end reversed, r.adjustment_id reversal_adjustment_id, r.reason reversal_reason, r.operator_name reversal_operator_name, r.create_time reversed_at from oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment a left join oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment r on r.original_adjustment_id = a.adjustment_id and r.adjustment_action = 'REVERSE' where a.target_day_result_id = #{targetDayResultId} and a.adjustment_action = 'APPLY' order by a.adjustment_id desc
select from oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment where adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} for update
select count(1) from oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment where original_adjustment_id = #{originalAdjustmentId} and adjustment_action = 'REVERSE'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into oa_attendance_time_credit_period_lock (shop_id, salary_month, create_time) values (#{shopId}, #{salaryMonth}, now())
mapper.select: select 1 from oa_attendance_time_credit_period_lock where shop_id = #{shopId} and salary_month = #{salaryMonth} for update
mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment (adjustment_no, client_request_id, request_fingerprint, adjustment_action, original_adjustment_id, shop_id, user_id, user_name, salary_month, source_day_result_id, source_schedule_id, source_business_date, target_day_result_id, target_schedule_id, target_business_date, adjustment_minutes, reason, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time) values (#{adjustmentNo}, #{clientRequestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{adjustmentAction}, #{originalAdjustmentId}, #{shopId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{salaryMonth}, #{sourceDayResultId}, #{sourceScheduleId}, #{sourceBusinessDate}, #{targetDayResultId}, #{targetScheduleId}, #{targetBusinessDate}, #{adjustmentMinutes}, #{reason}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{createBy}, now())
